summary: Maya Cross called to report she was still experiencing slower speeds after upgrading her online speed despite the upgrade being applied. The agent confirmed the upgrade was active and initiated a profile re-provisioning process on her account. After a brief reconnection period, the speed increased significantly as per the agent’s instructions.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the correct greeting and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent correctly identified Maya Cross by her name.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged the customer’s frustration with slow speeds, validating their experience.

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a polite tone throughout the conversation, avoiding interruptions or defensive language.

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated the customer's issue ("So why is it slow?") to confirm understanding.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated Maya’s account details by confirming her name and company.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: The agent asked probing questions like "Can you do that now?" to understand the root cause of the problem.

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: – The agent clearly stated the next steps (pushing the new profile) and offered a speed test as confirmation.

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent successfully resolved the issue by pushing the new profile.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: The agent took responsibility for resolving the issue, even though it was an ongoing process.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened attentively to Maya’s explanation of the problem.

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution
ratings.reason: – The agent confirmed that the speed had improved after restarting her router.

suggestions: Wanted: To have the upgraded speed apply immediately.
Issue: Line hasn’t been re-provisioned to the new profile.
Check your router settings and ensure it’s connected correctly.
Run a speed test after restarting the router to confirm the change.

compliance.name: Discourtesy
compliance.rule: Never be discourteous: no profanity, bashing, impatience, or sarcasm toward the customer

compliance.name: Escalation
compliance.rule: Escalate to a supervisor when the customer asks

compliance.name: Call Avoidance
compliance.rule: Do not avoid the call: never refuse to help or push the customer away without a valid reason

response_times.client_text: I upgraded my speed online but I'm still getting the old speed.
response_times.agent_text: Let me look into that, upgrades don't always apply instantly. Verifying your account first.
Thanks, Maya. I can see the upgrade is on your account.
The line hasn't been re-provisioned to the new profile yet.
Yes, I'll push the new profile to your line right now.
Done. Please restart your router so it picks up the new speed.
Take your time, it needs a moment to reconnect.
Great, run a speed test whenever you like and you should see the higher figure.

response_times.client_text: Testing now... yes, it's much faster.
response_times.agent_text: Perfect. Anything else I can help with today?
